title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil Film Earns Estimated ₹24.24 Crore in India
content:
IGN India had reported on Tuesday that the film had collected ₹17.84 crore net at the Indian box office, making it the country's second highest grossing anime film.

The film opened in Indian theaters in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu on October 2. The film had a premiere screening for fans on September 26 featuring character mascots from the franchise . The film earned ₹8.46 crore in its first three days at the Indian box office.

As the title indicates, this 45th 2D anime film (not counting the 3D CG Stand By Me Doraemon films) remakes the classic 1983 film Doraemon the Movie: Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil .

The film opened in Japan on February 27 and ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 621,000 tickets and earned 779,681,350 yen (about US$4.96 million) in its first three days. It ranked at #1 for six straight weekends. The film's release featured immersive "4D" screenings for the first time in the franchise .

Shōya Chiba voices the character El, a soldier of the Mu Federation tasked to keep an eye on Doraem on and his friends when they arrived at the bottom of the sea. Additionally, Ryō Hirohashi voices the Mizunaka Buggy (Underwater Buggy), the amphibious buggy car and one of Dorae mon's secret gadgets.

Actress Airi Taira is an ambassador for the film, along with comedy duo Alco & Peace. They voice soldiers in the film.

Tetsuo Yajima ( Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle , Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us , Pokémon XY ) returned after directing episodes of the Doraemon television anime and contributing in other capacities to Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's New Great Adventure into the Underworld , Doraemon the Movie: Nobita and the Steel Troops: The New Age , and Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Chikyū Symphony . Another veteran of the television anime, Isao Murayama ( Witchy Precure! , Star Twinkle Precure , Bakugan ), wrote the new film's screenplay.

Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Esekai Monogatari ( Doraemon: Nobita's Art World Tales ), the 44th film in the Doraemon franchise , opened in Japan in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: Singer Kenshi Yonezu to Hold Singapore Concert as Part of World Tour
content:
Sony Music announced on Thursday that singer-songwriter Kenshi Yonezu will go on a concert world tour in early 2027. The tour is titled " KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST." The tour will have a concert at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in Singapore on January 29, 2027.

Yonezu began his career as Vocaloid composer Hachi in 2009, and also illustrated the music videos for his songs. He released two albums as Hachi, before his third album diorama in 2012, where he sang using his real voice and credited himself under his real name Kenshi Yonezu .

Yonezu has performed theme songs for multiple anime and games, including Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli 's The Boy and the Heron ; My Hero Academia ; Chainsaw Man ; Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc ; Fireworks, Should We See it from the Side or the Bottom? ; Children of the Sea ; March comes in like a lion ; Final Fantasy XVI ; the live-action 5 Centimeters per Second film; the live-action Shin Ultraman film; and the live-action Look Back film (where he is credited as "Shark Kick Guitar").

title: AFA Singapore Features Overgeared Anime's Cast, Staff
content:
Crunchyroll and the AFA Singapore convention announced on Friday that one cast member and two staff members from the the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon will attend the convention, and will participate in a panel at the convention on November 28.

The panel will feature the anime's director Ayako Kōno , the anime's executive producer Nobuhiro Ōsawa , and Tatsumaru Tachibana , the voice of protagonist Grid.

The anime debuted in Japan on October 2. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in Southeast Asia as it airs in Japan.

Yen Press publishes the webtoon in English under its Ize Press label. Yen Press describes the story:

Youngwoo Shin is a deadbeat in real life, working odd jobs to barely pay off his loans. Even his family has written him off as a hopeless video game addict. But when he logs in to the massively popular VR game Satisfy, Youngwoo becomes Grid the Warrior…who is also painfully mediocre. Everything changes when he stumbles across a tome containing the lost knowledge of a legendary blacksmith. The catch is, using it resets all his levels! In order to survive after being forced back to square one, Grid will need to hone his skills and gather reliable allies…or not! Who needs all that when you're decked out in god-tier items?!

Ayako Kōno ( Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night , Sword Art Online The Movie - Progressive: Scherzo of Deep Night ) is directing the film at J.C. Staff , with EGG FIRM producing the anime. Kenta Ihara ( Saga of Tanya the Evil , Uncle From Another World , Blue Miburo ) is in charge of the series scripts, and Kenta Ihara ( Demon Lord 2099 , I Want to End This Love Game ) is designing the characters. Yoshikazu Iwanami is the sound director, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa is composing the music. Pony Canyon is credited for music production.

The AFA Singapore convention will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Opens in Hong Kong on November 19
content:
Hong Kong film distributor Neofilms announced on Wednesday that it will open Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — in Hong Kong on November 19. The film will have 4DX screenings alongside regular screenings.

The film opened in Japan on September 18, and ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. It sold 358,000 tickets to earn 446 million yen (about US$2.82 million) in its first three days. In its first six days until September 23, the film sold 606,000 tickets and earned 746 million yen (about US$4.71 million).

The film's story begins with the Detective Precures investigating the "X Mark Incident," when a fairy named Rain appears and requests for the Detective Precures' help. Rain leads the team to a lovely garden called "Karin's Garden," but it is being overrun by tiny creatures called "Dame Dame." The team investigates the "Dame Dame" creatures and discovers the secret hidden in the garden.

The cast members who voice the film's original characters are Akari Kitō as Karin, a 14-year-old girl who holds the key to the story; Nobunaga Shimazaki as Alan, a fairy who watches over Karin; and Kōki Uchiyama as Rain, a fairy who requests the Detective Precures' help.

Hanako Ueda ( You and Idol Precure♪ , Summer Time Rendering , My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON episode director) directed the film. Yoshimi Narita ( Eiga HappinessCharge PreCure! Ningyō no Kuni no Ballerina , Eiga Precure All Stars New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi , Eiga Tropical-Rouge! Precure: Yuki no Princess to Kiseki no Yubiwa! films) wrote the script, Erika Fukasawa ( Eiga Kimi to Idol Precure♪ Omatase! Kimi ni Todokeru Kirakkilive! ) and Misaki Umase ( You and Idol Precure♪ ) composed the music, and Emiko Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure All Stars F , Precure Super Stars! original character designer) designed the characters and was also the film's chief animation director.

The Star Detective Precure! anime debuted on February 1 on ABC TV, TV Asahi , and their affiliate channels at 8:30 a.m. JST.

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Wednesday that it will stream Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi — an omnibus short anime adaptation of Yū-hachi 's Dekai Hachi ; Miseban no Spis ; and Ah, Tanuki wa Mō Dame Desu manga — beginning on October 16 at 3:00 p.m. GMT +8.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

By Yū-hachi , a popular creator whose works have been consecutively nominated for the "Next Manga Award", the original characters that became a hot topic on social media are now getting a TV anime adaptation! Meet DEKAIHACHI, a plump and mysterious creature; pis-chan, a silent fish hanging in a convenience store; and Tanuki, a somewhat unreliable and clumsy raccoon dog. Together with humans, these lovable, quirky, and slightly peculiar creatures create a laid-back and surreal slice of everyday life. With its quirky world and unexpected encounters, this short-form comedy anime is sure to make you smile.

The anime debuted in Japan on October 5.

The anime stars:

• Chiaki as Dekaihachi

• Hina Kawata as Jirai-chan

• Fūka Izumi as Tanuki

• Ryōta Suzuki as Onii-san

• Kenta Sasa as Tenchō

• Tomo Miyazawa as Narrator

Rarecho ( Aggretsuko ) is directing and scripting the Miseban no Spis and Ah, Tanuki wa Mō Dame Desu segments, while Gaku Kinoshita ( Sumikko Gurashi: Koko ga Ochitsukun Desu ) is directing and scripting the Dekai Hachi segments. Fanworks is animating the series.

Dekai Hachi centers on a the titular character, a 40cm (roughly 1 foot and 3 inches) tall creature and his daily life alongside humans. Miseban no Spis centers on a mysterious fish that suddenly appears one day. Ah, Tanuki wa Mō Dame Desu centers on a tanuki that is rented by various people.

Yū-hachi draws both the Dekai Hachi and Miseban no Spis manga on pixiv . Square Enix released a combined book volume of Miseban no Spis in July 2024. Yū-hachi draws Ah, Tanuki wa Mō Dame Desu on their X/Twitter account, as well as Kadokawa 's KadoComi website . Kadokawa released a compiled book volume for the manga in June 2025.
author: ANN

title: Anime Limited Will Release City The Animation Collector's Blu-ray on December 14
content:
Anime Limited has announced on its AllTheAnime website that it will release a Collector's Blu-ray edition of Kyoto Animation 's CITY The Animation on December 14. Extras will include a 72-page booklet, four art cards, an A3 poster and the "Cut Out Movies 1-13."

Tamami Tokuyama (animation director for Sound! Euphonium: Ensemble Contest Arc , key animator for Liz and the Blue Bird ) is credited as both the character designer and chief animation director. Shiori Yamazaki (background art for Violet Evergarden: The Movie , Sound! Euphonium The Movie - Our Promise: A Brand New Day ) was the art director. Additionally, Kana Miyata was the color designer, Hiroki Ueda was the director of photography, Tatsunori Kase was the 3D director, and Yōta Tsuruoka was the sound director. The members of the quartet Piranhans composed the anime's music. Pony Canyon was in charge of music production.

Singer-songwriter Riho Furui performed the opening theme song "Hello," and singer-songwriter TOMOO performed the ending theme song "Lucky."

Taichi Ishidate ( Violet Evergarden , Beyond the Boundary ) directed the anime at Kyoto Animation . The anime was the first non-sequel anime for Kyoto Animation in six years.

Kyoto Animation described the anime:

This town, is not just a normal town. There's laughter, love and emotional moments. An unpredictable ordinary life presented by the residents! Exciting stuffs come one after another. Welcome to CITY.

Arawi ( Nichijou , Helvetica Standard ) launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in September 2016, and ended the series in February 2021. Kodansha published the 13th and final compiled book volume in April 2021.

Vertical (now Kodansha USA ) published the entire series in English. The manga is also available on Kodansha 's K MANGA service.

The manga returned in Kodansha 's Morning magazine on December 12.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Co-Creator Explains Choosing Potential Spinoffs & Sequels (Exclusive)
content:
Avatar Studios is now expanding the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise with new spinoffs and sequel series projects, and the co-creator behind it all has explained to ComicBook what they looked for in choosing an Avatar to explore for potential expanded stories and worlds. Avatar: Seven Havens has kicked off a new era of the franchise , and with it has already made waves with not only one, but two new Avatars at the center of this new adventure. But all of these stories have got to start somewhere.

With the premiere of Avatar: Seven Havens and recent confirmation of a new Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos series now in the works , ComicBook got to ask franchise co-creator Michael DiMartino about what he and fellow creator Bryan Konietzko look for in a potential Avatar to explore with a new spinoff or sequel release. As DiMartino explains it, the duo “…were very conscious of making sure each project felt different in genre and tone style and everything” while developing multiple Avatar Studios projects at the same time.

Avatar Co-Creator Explains Choosing New Sequel & Spinoff Projects

“When Brian [Konietzko] and I came to start Avatar Studios, since we were developing multiple things at once, we were very conscious of making sure each project felt different in genre and tone style and everything,” DiMartino began. Explaining that when approaching the work for Avatar: Seven Havens , the two of them knew it was going to be the “big sequel to the…not exactly a trilogy, but maybe it is now” story of Aang, Korra, and now the new main duo at the center of the sequel series, Pavi and Nisha. As a result, they were looking for it to feel “big.”

“It had to feel feel big, it had to feel epic, had to feel like something we had never done before,” DiMartino explained about breaking down Avatar: Seven Havens story . “So sort of literally blowing up the world to create these Seven Havens, and then we soon hit upon the idea of the two Avatars and how that could open up a lot of really cool storytelling possibilities.” The co-creator even went into why this sequel series is actually set so far after the events of The Legend of Korra.

Why Avatar: Seven Havens Is Hundreds of Years After The Legend of Korra

Explaining that the idea of setting Avatar: Seven Havens hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra was one of the first things the creator duo had settled on, it was because of an earlier idea they head of questioning, “What would the Avatar world look like in the future” along with giving the animated series “a little more fantasy vibe.” The co-creator also further went into how they develop the shows overall, “We usually start with what’s the state of the world now when we talk about different eras of the Avatar, and then usually the Avatar character comes out of those discussions.”

With this in mind of how the duo ultimately constructs their current view of the Avatar world first before then building out the story, it seems like they figure out what each Avatar at the center of it after setting the foundation. It’s how they ultimately settled on the story and dual main characters for Avatar: Seven Havens (now streaming with Paramount+ ), and it’s how they’re choosing which stories to explore. As long as they all feel different in everything from other projects.

What are you hoping to see next from Avatar Studios? What kind of Avatars would you want to see with spinoffs in the future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

“It had to feel feel big, it had to feel epic, had to feel like something we had never done before,” DiMartino explained about breaking down Avatar: Seven Havens story . “So sort of literally blowing up the world to create these Seven Havens, and then we soon hit upon the idea of the two Avatars and how that could open up a lot of really cool storytelling possibilities.” The co-creator even went into why this sequel series is actually set so far after the events of The Legend of Korra.
Why Avatar: Seven Havens Is Hundreds of Years After The Legend of Korra

Explaining that the idea of setting Avatar: Seven Havens hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra was one of the first things the creator duo had settled on, it was because of an earlier idea they head of questioning, “What would the Avatar world look like in the future” along with giving the animated series “a little more fantasy vibe.” The co-creator also further went into how they develop the shows overall, “We usually start with what’s the state of the world now when we talk about different eras of the Avatar, and then usually the Avatar character comes out of those discussions.”

With this in mind of how the duo ultimately constructs their current view of the Avatar world first before then building out the story, it seems like they figure out what each Avatar at the center of it after setting the foundation. It’s how they ultimately settled on the story and dual main characters for Avatar: Seven Havens (now streaming with Paramount+ ), and it’s how they’re choosing which stories to explore. As long as they all feel different in everything from other projects.
What are you hoping to see next from Avatar Studios? What kind of Avatars would you want to see with spinoffs in the future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dandadan, Jujutsu Kaisen & More Confirm New U.S. Releases With Major Manga Updates
content:
DAN DA DAN, Jujutsu Kaisen and more major franchises have confirmed they have some new manga, book and more releases coming to the United States thanks to a new license update. Viz Media has revealed some major updates to its physical English license slate for the next year, and with it have confirmed some cool new projects and releases that anime fans are going to want to keep an eye out for in the months to come. Some of which are going to be welcome returns for their respective hits.

Viz Media have taken to their social media over the weekend to reveal all sorts of new releases they now have in the works beginning in Summer 2027 next year. The standout licenses of the group are DAN DA DAN: The Official Character Guide , the official first volume release of Ei Yamano’s Someone Hertz , the first volume of Kyo Tanimoto’s Under Doctor, Jujutsu Kaisen: The Official Coloring Book and more. Read on below for a breakdown of their new announcements.

Viz Media Confirms New Manga & More Releases for 2027

As Viz Media confirmed through their official social media account, the following releases have been announced for a Summer 2027 launch:

• Jujutsu Kaisen: The Official Coloring Book

• DAN DA DAN: The Official Character Guide by Yukinobu Tatsu

• Someone Hertz Vol. 1 by Ei Yamano

• Under Doctor Vol. 1 by Kyo Tanimoto

• JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Part 8—JoJolion Vol. 1 by Hirohiko Araki

• Bus for Two Vol. 1 by Sakane Toyobayashi

• Astray Vol. 1 by Wishroomness and Keon Tan

• His Sweet Solace Vol. 1 by Rose Takada

• Diabo a Quatro Vol. 1 by Mariana

• Belladonna’s Lover by Ru1mm

• The Gifted Gene: 70% of My Body is Made of Movies by Hideo Kojima

• Howl’s Moving Castle Film Comic: All-in-One Edition

There are some major standouts of this batch as Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s coloring book is going to feature 80 pages of Gege Akutami’s original art for fans to fill in with their own vision. DAN DA DAN: The Official Character Guide comes from the manga’s creator Yukinobu Tatsu that includes lots of new details about each of the characters not seen in the original manga, and even includes 22 pages of a brand new story never seen before.

What’s Next for Jujutsu Kaisen and DAN DA DAN ?

DAN DA DAN and Jujutsu Kaisen now have some big projects in the works for a launch in the immediate future. DAN DA DAN Season 3 is currently slated for a release sometime in 2027, but has yet to confirm a concrete release date as of this time. This is the same case for Jujutsu Kaisen as it is now in the works on the anime’s fourth season. Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 will be picking up from the first half of the Culling Game arc, and will be showing off all sorts of big fights to come.

With both franchises having more anime in the works, it’s a good thing that both series have been confirmed as part of the line up of titles that Shueisha will be showcasing during Jump Festa 2027 later this December. Taking place over the December 19-20 weekend, this event will be giving fans big updates on all of the new franchises that now have something on the way.

Are you excited for these new manga and book releases coming from Viz Media? What are you hoping to see from Jujutsu Kaisen and DAN DA DAN next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Is Now Streaming With Netflix After New Update
content:
Dragon Ball Super has now returned to action with a new remake series after eight long years, and now the new series is streaming with Netflix after its latest update. There are going to be a lot of major new and returning shows that are going to be competing for all of your attention this month as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , but there’s one that’s likely going to draw lots of attention either way as Dragon Ball Super has kicked off a fully enhanced remake.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original Dragon Ball Super TV anime series that made its debut over a decade ago at this point, and the first episode made its debut across other streaming platforms last week . But now with a new update, the premiere episode is now available to stream with Netflix with its new episodes coming to the platform on a weekly basis from here on out. It’s just going to be a bit behind the others.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Premieres With Netflix

The first episode of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is now streaming with Netflix, and it’s going to be about a week behind the anime’s original release in Japan and streaming launches with Hulu and Crunchyroll. The first episode also helps to clear up what kind of project this new series is going to be. Because while there are new scenes and adjustments made to how the original TV series had unfolded, it’s not going to be as “new” as what many fans might have hoped for with the anime’s return.

Because while Dragon Ball Super fans had been hoping for some brand new materials that would line up the canon further ahead of the release of Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol, it turns out that this is not going to be the case. Voice star Koichi Yamadera (who voices Beerus) has confirmed that they have not recorded any new audio for the anime , so its updates aren’t going to include brand new fully voiced scenes. It’s instead going to be the team working with what was already made available. Which likely means that it’s going to be the same case for the English dub if it gets one down the line.

What to Know for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus had been touted by Toei Animation to be an “enhanced” version of the original TV anime series with “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story.” But with Yamadera already revealing new dubbing has not taken place for at least his character, we’ll have to see whether or not that’s the case for the rest of the remake.

Even if this new Dragon Ball Super anime isn’t as new as fans might hope for, there’s at least some brand new anime now in the works for the future too. Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is a brand new anime adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner Arc from the manga release, and is the first of two arcs yet to get an official anime release. No release date or production staff has been revealed for it thus far, but it’s certainly an exciting thing to keep an eye out for.

How have you been liking Dragon Ball Super’ s new remake anime so far? What are you hoping to see before it ends? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
